title: On the existence of cycles of given length in integer sequences like x_(n+1) = x_n/2 if x_n even, and x_(n+1) = 3x_n + 1 otherwise
publication: Atti della Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei. Classe di Scienze Fisiche, Matematiche e Naturali. Rendiconti, series 8, 64 (3), 260-264

consultation.scope: Original five-page article and BDIM cover recovered from a mirror. Introduction and Section 2 read; Propositions 4-7 on pages 263-264 also checked against rendered images.
consultation.remaining: The general piecewise-affine claims in Section 1 were not audited. The mirror's separate Lean project was neither executed nor accepted as independent verification.

notes: Classical affine iterate and cycle parametrizations; Proposition 6 gives |x| < 3^n for a periodic integer of the shortcut map u with u^n(x)=x. Here n counts shortcut steps, not odd blocks or accelerated returns. The introduction explicitly includes negative integers and their positive 3x-1 counterpart. Relevant prior art for signed cycle identities in Paper D; no universal termination result follows.
